_comment: Schema descriptions keyed by wildcarded paths (single source; applied by scripts/gen_schema_lib.py annotate()). '*' matches one segment.
packages/*/published_at: Package id of the current latest version — the tx-call target. Changes on every upgrade.
packages/*/original_id: Package id of the FIRST publish. Never changes across upgrades; used to build type tags (<original_id>::module::Type).
packages/*/version: On-chain package version: 1 at first publish, +1 per upgrade.
packages/*/upgrade_capability: UpgradeCap object id. Deploy-time artifact; no runtime consumer.
packages/*/mvr: Move Registry (MVR) registration for this package. Mainnet only today.
packages/waterx_rule/feeds: QC feed registry, keyed by oracle symbol. The `weights` inside are OFF-CHAIN ONLY: waterx_rule on-chain validates sources/ticker/method/min_sources but has no notion of weights, so a weight change moves the signed price via a parameter no on-chain check can see (waterx-quote-center audit-scope I-16). Review weight changes as a trust-surface change.
packages/waterx_rule/enclave_pubkey: Registered enclave ed25519 pubkey (hex, no 0x). The SOLE config home; k8s-infra pins an independent env copy by design (boot-without-enclave).
packages/pyth_rule/feeds: Per-symbol Pyth price feed: feed_id (Pyth) + price_info_object (Sui object the keeper refreshes).
packages/pyth_lazer_rule/feeds: Per-symbol Pyth Lazer numeric feed id, as used by the keeper's Lazer WS subscription.
packages/waterx_oracle/aggregators: Per-symbol on-chain Aggregator object id — the cross-rule weighted-median aggregation point.
packages/waterx_perp/markets: Per-symbol perp market: market + config object ids.
symbols: The single symbol universe: the ONLY place a symbol is introduced. Every symbol-keyed map elsewhere must reference a key from here (CI-enforced).
oracle_rules/waterx/venue_feeds: QC feed registry (was packages.waterx_rule.feeds). `weights` remain OFF-CHAIN ONLY — audit-scope I-16 trust surface.
oracle_rules/waterx/enclave: The ONE home for enclave identity (object, cap, config, pubkey).
oracle_rules/waterx/enclave/pubkey: Registered enclave ed25519 pubkey (hex, no 0x). The SOLE config home; k8s-infra pins an independent env copy by design (boot-without-enclave).
